5 / Observation What the bench supports Forty engineering samples were assembled. Six were tested on the bench. None went to customers. Two years is a projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest run was 72 hours. One preliminary emissions check passed. Full qualification is unfinished.
